_note: Each upload goes into one mood playlist (the best keyword match, or the fallback) and, if any keyword matches, one season playlist. Keywords are matched against the theme's English fields as whole words or word starts. Playlists are created on the channel the first time they are needed; their IDs are saved in data/playlist_ids.json.
